Another look-and-feel choice, so I'll just give you my preference — both land me in the same private collection, so either is fine.

If I'm picking: since it's just me and I open this all the time, I lean toward the plain password. Typing a password I know is quicker than waiting for a code to arrive and copying it over every time. The emailed-code approach feels like extra waiting for something I use constantly. So my pick is email-and-password. Not a strong feeling. Let's keep moving.
